newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia to change local telephone rates.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia to change local telephone rates.

text.p: Indonesia said on Monday it planned to raise the local telephone rate, while lowering the cost of regional calls from January 1.
Jonathon Parapak, secretary-general of the Tourism, Post and Telecommunications ministry said the local rate would be increased to 115 rupiah per pulse from the current 110 rupiah.
Parapak said at the same time the regional direct dialing rate would fall to 108 rupiah per pulse from the current 110 rupiah.
The cost of a call from a GSM mobile phone also fell to 270 rupiah per pulse from 275 rupiah.
For local calls, one pulse covers three minutes, however for regional and mobile phone calls the pulse time is much shorter and varies according to the distance of the call.

"The decision to change the rate is not new. We have already made it public that we planned to change telephone rates as well as the rationale and the formula of the (rate) plan," he told a news conference.
Parapak was responding to newspaper reports on Monday that the government was expected to change local telephone rates.
He said the changes were necessary because of inflation and because of recent investment in the telecommunications sector.
Parapak declined to further elaborate on the changes.
